At approximately 7 inches across (as shown by the ruler), it offers substantial presence whether showcased on a shelf or used as a sophisticated accent piece. Its sturdy build and unique visual appeal make it ideal for collectors, educators, or anyone seeking natural beauty for their decor. The condition appears very good overall, with clean surfaces and only minor natural roughness on the edges. Please refer to photos for the exact condition and dimensions before purchasing.
